title: CDotNullable
description: A Forge Mod for 1.8.9 (will be for multiple versions eventually) that adds QOL features. Currently Copying Coordinates is the first feature.
body:
- Adds a bind to gamesettings
- Mixins to Minecraft's ontick to detect its own keybind
- correctly saves and loads from mc.gamesettings
- Allows proper changing of the Coordinate copy trigger bind
- More features coming soon!
